angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 494,643 km at 135.88 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.3592 +/- 0.0180 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 135.88 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.711 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2374 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract): 494,643 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.802 +/- 0.029 solar masses from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2374 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5002 +/- 65 K from Yee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2374 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Yee et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2374 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2374.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.639, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2374 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.128 dex, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2374 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.54516, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2374 (pscomppars): age 4.5 Gyr, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2374 (pscomppars): rotation period 26.4 d, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2374 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.42 km/s, from Yee et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170..275Y/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.711 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.308. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
